body.name: Finite-sample DKW fallback radius
body.construction: Using equal pre and post allocations of the error budget, set \(\varepsilon_{n,\ell}=\sqrt{\log(4(J+1)T_0/\alpha)/(2n_\ell)}\), \(\varepsilon_{m,\ell}=\sqrt{\log(4(J+1)T_1/\alpha)/(2m_\ell)}\), compute \(R_{w,\ell}\) as declared, and set \(R^{\mathrm{DKW}}_\ell=\min\{2D,2D\sqrt{\varepsilon_{m,\ell}}+D\sqrt J R_{w,\ell}\}\).
